commonPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D combat VFX overlay sprite sheet for AlarmQuest. Create exactly 16 chronological frames in a strict 4-column by 4-row row-major sheet. Every cell is one independent 361x160 combat viewport; the final sheet must be exactly 1444x640. Detailed hand-painted high-resolution Korean fantasy action-RPG rendering, transparent 8-bit RGBA, smooth antialiased alpha, image-rendering auto, never pixel art. This batch is a sword-master collection: every active frame must read as ONE connected physical sword with a continuous blade, crossguard, grip and pommel. The exact sword design may differ between skills but must remain geometrically identical inside one skill sheet. Never show a wielder, body, hand, enemy or complete background. Use a fixed camera, fixed scale and the skill-specific immutable sword path and contact point. The sword moves as one rigid object without redraw wobble, bending, rescaling, reverse motion, rebound or duplicate copies. Shared late-impact chronology overrides the generic early-peak contract: F01-F04 completely transparent; F05 one restrained anticipation glint; F06-F09 show the same sword preparing or accelerating without target damage; F10-F12 contain the fast readable traversal; F13 is the FIRST physical contact; F14 is compression or continuation into that same contact; F15 is the one UNIQUE MAXIMUM impact; F16 holds the same final contact tableau at 75-85% energy with only tiny forward fragment travel. F16 is not recovery and is not an image fade because the web renderer holds it through 1099ms and linearly fades it from 1100ms to 1350ms. F15 and F16 must retain the recognizable connected sword. For techniques with several cuts, show only one full sword in each cell and use thin subordinate wake marks for earlier strokes; all visible damage resolves into the final F15 contact. Keep the top, bottom, left and right six pixels of every cell completely transparent. Treat each cell as sealed: no adjacent-frame leakage, horizontal image strip, bottom residue or illustrated ground band. Maintain generous transparent corridors around separate pressure layers. No skill may reuse another skill's path, contact position, silhouette or peak composition. Render VFX and the connected sword only, with no text, labels, grid, border, padding, UI or opaque background.
